payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.criteria: complete: the image is a chalk drawing; partial: some visible progress toward making it a chalk drawing, but it is not complete; absent: no requested change has progressed; unknown: evidence is insufficient to determine progress or completion. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.

response.content: {"text":"The node’s criterion appears too permissive: all five runs call the edit complete based on graininess, smudging, and softened outlines, but the edited image still retains photographic detail and shading, so those cues alone do not establish a completed chalk drawing. Refine the criterion to distinguish a chalk-like filter or partial stylization from an image that reads consistently as a drawing, and require evidence across the scene rather than treating texture alone as decisive. Preserve partial when there is visible progress but the photographic appearance remains; reserve unknown for genuinely insufficient visual evidence. The repeated high-confidence yes votes indicate a systematic threshold/calibration issue, not transport or dependency failure (all traces are valid, complete, and queried). Keep the requested transformation intact and avoid adding unrelated requirements."}
